source.imageAlt: The Ranked Leagues screen shows ranks from Rookie to Apex Predator. The ranks are highlighted in a red box.

rights.licenseNote: These are third-party game UI excerpts from an official EA help article. No permissive license or ownership of the original artwork is claimed.

currentRankEvidence.summary: EA help lists Rookie, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Master, and Apex Predator; Predator is the top 750 Master players per platform.

futureChangesExcluded.summary: Iron replaces Rookie; Emerald and Grandmaster are planned under the Season 32 section. These future ranks are not part of this current icon set.

limitations: Source screenshot is 800×450; each icon is a small exact crop with the original in-game card background.
The image set represents the rank artwork shown in the official EA help screenshot; it is not an invented or generated recreation.

verification.decode: All 8 PNGs decoded successfully with Pillow.
verification.nonblank: All 8 PNGs have nonzero dimensions and channel standard deviation greater than 10.
verification.visualReview: All 8 crops were reviewed together against the full official screenshot; each contains the corresponding rank emblem and no rank label or rewards text.
